title: HR Assistant
description:
HR Administrator / HR Coordinator

Full-Time Office Based Salary: Up to 32,000 per annum

Join a Growing and People-Focused Business

Are you an organised and proactive HR professional looking to take the next step in your career?

We are seeking an enthusiastic HR Administrator / HR Coordinator to join our busy and supportive HR team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous HR administration experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and wants to broaden their exposure across all areas of Human Resources whilst also supporting payroll activities.

You'll play a key role in ensuring the smooth running of the HR function, providing first-class administrative support and helping to deliver an excellent employee experience throughout the employee lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
- Supporting the HR team with all aspects of HR administration
- Managing employee records and maintaining accurate HR databases
- Producing employment contracts, offer letters and HR correspondence
- Assisting with onboarding and induction processes for new starters
- Coordinating recruitment activities, including interview scheduling and candidate communication
- Processing HR documentation relating to starters, leavers and employee changes
- Supporting monthly payroll by collating and checking information such as absence, overtime and employee changes
- Monitoring annual leave, sickness and other employee records
- Responding to HR-related queries from employees and managers
- Assisting with HR projects, training coordination and employee engagement initiatives
- Ensuring compliance with company policies and employment legislation

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience within an HR Administration, HR Assistant or HR Coordinator role
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail
- Confident handling confidential and sensitive information
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word
- Experience supporting payroll processes would be advantageous
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Ability to prioritise workload and work effectively in a busy environment
- A positive, proactive and team-focused attitude

What's on Offer?

Salary up to 32,000

Full-time permanent position

Opportunity to gain exposure to all areas of HR

Supportive and collaborative working environment

Ongoing training and career development opportunities

The chance to be part of a growing and successful organisation

Interested?

If you're looking for a varied HR role where no two days are the same and you can make a real impact while developing your career, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV to be considered for this exciting opportunity.

title: Part Time HR Assistant
description:
HR Assistant (Part-Time)

Basildon & Laindon 25-30 Hours Per Week 20,000 - 24,000 Per Annum

Must be a driver with access to your own vehicle

Salary: 20,000 - 24,000 per annum depending on agreed hours (equivalent to 30,000 per annum based on a full-time 37.5-hour week).

Adore Recruitment are currently recruiting for a Part-Time HR Assistant on behalf of a well-established and growing organisation. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and proactive administrator looking to develop their career within Human Resources whilst gaining exposure to a broad range of HR responsibilities.

Working across sites in Basildon and Laindon, you will provide vital support to the HR team, helping to ensure the smooth delivery of HR processes, compliance activities, employee records management, recruitment administration and training coordination. Due to the dual-site nature of the role, applicants must hold a full UK driving licence and have access to their own vehicle.

The Role

As HR Assistant, you will play a key role in supporting employees and managers across the business by providing efficient administrative and operational HR support. Responsibilities will include:
- Providing day-to-day administrative support to the HR function.
- Coordinating and monitoring mandatory training requirements.
- Supporting recruitment activities, onboarding and offboarding processes.
- Managing absence and leave administration.
- Producing HR reports and supporting internal audits.
- Maintaining accurate employee records and HR documentation.
- Supporting both office-based and site-based employees across the organisation.

About You
- Previous administration experience, ideally within HR.
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
- Confidence communicating with employees and managers at all levels.
- A professional and confidential approach when handling sensitive information.
- A full UK driving licence and access to your own vehicle.

Benefits
- 20,000 - 24,000 salary depending on agreed hours ( 30,000 full-time equivalent).
- Flexible part-time hours (25-30 hours per week, Monday to Friday).
- 20 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Company pension scheme.
- Virtual GP service.
- Employee Assistance Programme.
- Employee discount scheme.

If you're an organised and professional administrator looking to develop your HR career within a supportive and expanding business, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV or contact Nicki for further information.

title: Temporary HR Administrator/PA
description:
HR Administrator & PA Chelmsford 18 per hour Ongoing Temporary Assignment

Your new company

A well-established and highly regarded organisation based in Chelmsford is seeking an experienced HR Administrator & PA to join their team on an ongoing temporary basis. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and professional administrator who enjoys working in a varied role, supporting both HR operations and senior leadership. The role is based in a modern office with free on-site parking and offers hybrid working once training has been completed.

Your new role
Reporting to the HR Manager, with additional support responsibilities to the Managing Director, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth running of HR administration and executive support activities.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Supporting all aspects of the employee life cycle, including onboarding, employee changes and leavers.
- Maintaining accurate HR records, databases and personnel files.
- Managing absence administration and annual leave records.
- Coordinating training activities and employee engagement initiatives.
- Acting as a first point of contact for HR-related enquiries.
- Providing confidential PA support to the Managing Director.
- Diary management, meeting coordination and travel arrangements.
- Preparing reports, presentations and correspondence.
- Taking meeting minutes and following up on actions.
- Supporting leadership meetings and company events.

What you'll need to succeed

To be successful in this role, you will have previous experience within HR Administration, HR Assistant, Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant or a similar administrative position. You will possess excellent organisational skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Experience handling confidential information and strong Microsoft Office skills are essential. HR systems experience and a CIPD qualification would be advantageous.

What you'll get in return
- 18 per hour
- Immediate start available
- Ongoing temporary assignment with the potential to continue until a permanent appointment is made
- Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:00pm, with flexibility around working hours
- Initially office-based five days per week for training and onboarding
- Hybrid working available once fully trained
- Free on-site parking
- Friendly and supportive working environment

What you need to do now

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or contact Sarah Stone at Hays for a confidential discussion.
